verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is a SaaS service that processes cardholder and transaction data, so whether it offers an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any training opt-out, data-use control, or AI-training policy. The only ML mention is risk scoring on authorizations, which is a different feature and says nothing about training opt-outs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
